After 100% completion, a gamer's final thoughts on FFXV

• This guy gives the canker sore of a combat system far too much credit. The game probably would have been better if it had gone back to turn based or semi-realtime systems used by older FF games.

  • The story is OK, but if you didn't watch the tie-in movie you'll struggle to understand why things are happening. They want you to buy that by the way. You read that right. In order to get a proper backstory for current events in the game you have to purchase or rent a movie. Even the lackluster Deus Ex: Mankind Divided included a reasonably well presented backstory video to account for the events in all the previous games that culminate in to the present situation. At no additional charge.

  • The characters seem to literally not give a shit about the domination of their home city or the murder of the protagonists father. There is no sense of urgency. Emotion is pretty stunted for a group that just had their king killed and their country usurped. After they learn about these events it still feels like a bros-before-hoes road trip instead of a critical mission. The main characters are flat, forgettable and have almost zero development or depth. A huge step backwards for Final Fantasy.

  • Missions are boring as fuck. Many are repetitive and monotonous. Yeah I've got a kingdom to save, but I've got time to go collect 10 mutant pig anuses for you no problem. Oh, wait...

  • The open world of the game is marred by the fact that there's so little to do in it. Mostly it's scenery with little substance. You can't even camp where you want - you're forced to either seek paid lodging or set up camp in specifically designated zones.

  • Even driving your luxury car down the road feels like a yawnfest on rails since you can't leave the road or even hit anything without the game forcing you back in to your lane unscathed. You can in fact not drive at all as the AI will happily do it for you.

  • Maybe you'll find it more interesting than I did, but the fishing minigame is annoying as fuck and I hate it. I disagree completely with the article author on this.

I can't in any good faith recommend this game to anyone. It's visually pretty, but horrible as a FF game.
